```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent_bachelors_plus = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_plus),
    y = percent_bachelors_plus
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
```
